description: Run a scrape job now: fetch its page once, read the prices with its selectors and record the run. The answer is the run, with the prices found and its status. Hosted scraping is behind a release flag: until it is on for your workspace this answers 501 hosted_scraping_not_enabled. Runs honour robots.txt and fetch only public https pages. Needs a Last Price credential with the commerce:configure scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

job_id.description: The scrape job UUID: id on a list_scrape_jobs result.

name: run_scrape_job
